messages:
lucy_sales: Heads-up: Sentinel wants a POC next week to validate 'sentinel-13b-ops' + a q4_0-lite quant path for their orchestration layer. They asked for latency for streaming, KV/cache compatibility, answers to their security questionnaire (BYOK/HSM/residency), and a concise POC price. Can we triage?

omar_se: I can own fidelity checks. Do they route mostly short control messages or long transcripts?

lucy_sales: Mostly short (10-40 tokens) but sometimes attach a 900+ token system dump. Burst-y from edge gateways.

felix_infra: Note: sentinel-13b-ops has two KV options in our catalog: compact-kv and hybrid-row. Hybrid-row stabilizes tail at the cost of throughput. I'll run mixed-seq benches.

ida_sec: Security: they require customer-managed keys and EU residency option. They also want confirmation we run artifact scans and can provide an onboarding audit. Hosted POC preferred; Dedicated if HSM is mandatory.

nora_prod: For hosted we support KMS passthrough. I'll draft suggested questionnaire wording and a one-page POC template once we pick deployment mode.

ci-bot: Spawning ephemeral test cluster for sentinel-13b-ops. Job 77200 started.

felix_infra: Suggested bench (internal):

```bash
redwood-bench --model sentinel-13b-ops --variant q4_0-lite,float16 --kv-layout compact-kv,hybrid-row --seq-dist sentinel-mix.json --concurrency 12 --streaming true --measure p95,p99,tokens_per_sec
```

felix_infra: Quick smoke: short-only p95 float16 ~95ms, q4_0-lite ~120ms. Mixed with 900-token spikes p95 float16 ~460ms, q4_0-lite ~710ms at concurrency 12. Hybrid-row cut p99 by ~16% vs compact at the cost of ~10% tokens/sec.

omar_se: I'll request a 40-prompt eval set from Sentinel to run deterministic diffs between float16 and q4_0-lite. We should highlight numeric/stop-token diffs.

ida_sec: Draft security snippet: "Hosted POC: customer-managed KMS via passthrough; encrypted at rest/in transit; binary checksum and static scans performed. HSM-backed keys available on Dedicated/Private deployments; third-party attestations can be scoped."

nora_prod: Pricing sketch: 2-week hosted POC block, discounted token bucket, ops support during demo, optional Dedicated uplift for HSM. I'll share details privately.

felix_infra: CI job 77200 deployed sentinel-13b-ops v1.1 on ephemeral-dev. Logs uploaded. Action items: @omar_se run fidelity diffs when prompts arrive; @felix_infra attach full bench logs and mitigation checklist (doing that now); @ida_sec finalize sec answers & attach onboarding audit; @nora_prod prepare 1-page POC price card. Target: Wed EOD.

lucy_sales: CSM said they'll send the 40 prompts by EOD. Demo tentative until we validate outputs. Thanks team :thumbsup:
